Hotel SOPs — The Complete 10-Department Guide

Standard Operating Procedures are the backbone of successful hotel operations. They ensure consistency, efficiency, guest satisfaction, and service excellence across every department. Here's a department-by-department breakdown you can use as a working reference.

By Nigel A. Thomas · Hospitality Executive & Corporate Trainer
In 30+ years across luxury hotels, resorts, cruise lines, and F&B operations, I've seen the same truth play out again and again: properties that run well aren't the ones with the most talented individuals — they're the ones with the clearest, most consistently followed SOPs. Below is a full breakdown across all ten operational departments.

The 10 Departments

1Front Office SOPs

Focus: Guest interaction & first impressions

  • Reservation handling (booking, amendments, cancellations)
  • Check-in procedures (registration, room allocation, upselling)
  • Check-out process (billing accuracy, payment handling)
  • Guest complaint handling & service recovery
  • Cash handling & shift closing
  • Room status coordination with Housekeeping
  • VIP & repeat guest recognition
2Housekeeping SOPs

Focus: Cleanliness & room readiness

  • Room cleaning sequence (stayover, departure, deep cleaning)
  • Public area cleaning standards
  • Linen & laundry management
  • Lost & found procedures
  • Room inspection checklist
  • Minibar replenishment
  • Maintenance issue reporting
3Food & Beverage (F&B) SOPs

Focus: Service quality & hygiene

  • Restaurant opening & closing procedures
  • Table setup & service sequence (à la carte / buffet)
  • Order taking & POS usage
  • Food safety & hygiene (HACCP compliance)
  • Bar operations & beverage service
  • Banquet event setup & coordination
  • Guest handling & upselling techniques
4Kitchen (Culinary) SOPs

Focus: Food production & safety

  • Food preparation standards & recipes
  • Portion control & plating guidelines
  • Kitchen hygiene & sanitation
  • Food storage (FIFO – First In, First Out)
  • Temperature control & monitoring
  • Waste management
  • Coordination with service team
5Reservations SOPs

Focus: Revenue accuracy & inventory control

  • Booking entry standards (data accuracy)
  • Rate code application & restrictions
  • Availability control & overbooking strategy
  • Group reservations handling
  • OTA & channel management
  • Forecasting & reporting
6Finance / Accounts SOPs

Focus: Financial control & compliance

  • Daily revenue reconciliation (Night Audit)
  • Accounts receivable & payable
  • Cash handling & banking procedures
  • Credit management
  • Financial reporting
  • Cost control measures
7Engineering & Maintenance SOPs

Focus: Asset upkeep & safety

  • Preventive maintenance schedule
  • Work order management
  • Energy conservation procedures
  • Emergency response (power failure, fire systems)
  • Equipment inspection logs
8Security SOPs

Focus: Safety & risk management

  • Access control & surveillance
  • Emergency procedures (fire, evacuation)
  • Incident reporting
  • Guest & staff safety protocols
  • Key control management
9Sales & Marketing SOPs

Focus: Revenue generation

  • Lead handling & conversion process
  • Corporate & travel agent contracting
  • Site inspection procedures
  • Event sales coordination
  • Market analysis & competitor tracking
  • CRM updates
10Human Resources SOPs

Focus: People & culture

  • Recruitment & onboarding
  • Training & development
  • Attendance & payroll processing
  • Performance appraisal
  • Health & safety compliance
Standardize Processes.Elevate Experiences.
Consistent SOPs.Stronger Results.
Trained Teams.Happier Guests. Better Business.

Numbers tell you what happened. People tell you why. Pause long enough to hear both — that's the philosophy behind every SOP framework I build. SOPs aren't paperwork for its own sake; they're the mechanism that lets a property deliver the same standard of service on a slow Tuesday as on a sold-out Saturday.
